original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹本提乌流离失所者营地法庭启用，旨在加强司法可及性
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 联合国南苏丹特派团与团结州政府、南苏丹司法机构及司法与宪法事务部合作，支持本提乌境内流离失所者营地法庭于2026年9月7日至26日部署运作。该法庭将审理性暴力和性别暴力、毒品及帮派暴力相关案件，旨在将正式司法系统直接带给营地居民。该举措源于社区对加强司法与法治机制的反复关切与请求。

location.site: 本提乌境内流离失所者营地
location.raw_text: Bentiu IDP Camp, Unity State, South Sudan

key_facts.fact: 本提乌境内流离失所者营地法庭于2026年9月7日至26日部署运作
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: UNMISS is supporting the deployment of the Bentiu Internally Displaced Persons Camp Court from 7–26 September 2026

key_facts.fact: 该法庭将审理性暴力和性别暴力、毒品及帮派暴力相关案件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Court, which begins operations today, will hear cases relating to SGBV, drugs and gang violence

key_facts.fact: 该法庭部署源于社区对加强司法与法治机制的反复关切与请求
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: in response to repeated concerns and requests from the community for stronger justice and rule of law mechanisms

key_facts.fact: 本提乌流离失所者营地是南苏丹最大的境内流离失所者营地，收容超过10万人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Bentiu IDP camp is South Sudan’s largest camp for internally displaced persons, hosting more than 100,000 people

key_facts.fact: 该法庭由挪威驻朱巴大使馆资助
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Bentiu IDP Camp Court is funded by the Royal Norwegian Embassy in Juba

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（UNMISS），尚缺乏交叉验证
